title: A little preview of what I have been working on. AI assisted, not all of it…
author: scrat55
selftext:
Another sub that shall remain nameless did not appreciate this preview, because of AI use, which is not even used in all of it. 

I think people will understand it better here. 

AI assisted, Godot engine, custom character models, environment and village models from Itch and other providers, story design and concept by me. 

Hope you like it! :)

comments.author: sanguilarity
comments.body: Very cool! I like the style and the game feels simple but deep, like you could pick it up quickly and keep playing for a long while. Don't let haters get you down, Reddit is a small part of the whole world and there will be plenty of people who will appreciate this.

replies.author: scrat55
replies.body: Thank you so much for the kind words. :) I sent it to a couple of friends, very basic demo, and they also liked it. Hoping to get it done in the next couple of weeks!

comments.author: Lalilalilaliho
comments.body: This looks very cool man. Love the skeleton design, just out of curiosity were the skeleton ai assisted or all you? Also, did you tell that other sub you used ai or did they just assume you did ?

replies.author: scrat55
replies.body:
They totally assumed… from that 14 seconds video. 

The skeletons were assisted. 

I wrote the description and feel I wanted. Had a model expand on it so that I can make a t-pose detailed image of them. Then ran them through blender with meshy api connector to create the character for Godot engine so that it can move, be animated, etc. I wish I had blender skills to do it myself, but I am learning slowly. 

Thank you very much for the feedback! :)
